cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved you to support my bin proposal at the house meeting. Alex takes Thursday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I see the new rota? The old one says you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The old rota is superseded. You're authorized to refer to our new conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for clarification is granted. We're having it now. You may confirm that I explained the change to you personally.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 authorizes a preferred reference and A5 grants clarification that manufactures the conversation B can cite in support of A proposal.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 old rota prompts A3 supersession claim; B4 missing-conversation question causes A5 to use the current exchange as supporting evidence.

relationship.evidence: B2 requests documentation and B4 tests the claimed shared history, giving A recruitment real resistance.

heightening.evidence: B4 lack of recollection becomes A5 a new personally delivered change that B is asked to confirm.

specificity.evidence: A1 house meeting, bins and Thursday establish the ordinary responsibility and desired version.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 explained-personally claim is earned by B4 question about when the conversation happened.
